current_policy: R1, all bias devices and other resistor values unchanged initially. Nominal branch current is intended near baseline, so per-unit Q1/Q2 current density is approximately one quarter. Actual current, VREF, TC and pbias/pcasc must be checked before any mismatch campaign.
test_mode: Q1B also scaled to4 separate units, preserving the intended r4high area ratio8:32=1:4.
parasitics: Existing C-PEX retained for unchanged circuit, plus intrinsic models of30 added units. New array wiring, fill, coupling, substrate effects and layout are NOT extracted. This is a schematic-addition candidate, not regenerated PEX or physical sign-off.
spatial_statistics: Independent unit-local PDK qarea draws omit real spatial correlation; predicted averaging is not a measured silicon-yield claim.
layout_status: not run: no placement/routing/DRC/LVS or footprint acceptance for the enlarged arrays.
